entries.en:
Methuli Cattlan has asked you craft for her three high-quality gyrodrive components for the Dezul Qualan. Unfortunately, the materials required in their synthesis have been stolen in transit by the Ixal who dwell in the logging grounds. Make your way to Alder Springs, and retrieve the materials from the storage pot in which they are kept.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en: You have delivered the gyrodrive components to Methuli Cattlan, who squawks in sheer delight. Having heaped praise upon your craftsmanship, she goes on to express her disdain for her brethren who blindly worship Garuda. It would seem that birds of a feather do not necessarily flock together.

entries.en: Squawk! Outdone yourself, you have! Most excellent parts, these are! One day, from many malms above, laugh at minions of greedy goddess, we will!
entries.fr: Hé, c'est que c'est pas de la fiente, tes trucs... Avec une qualité de fabrication pareille, aucun doute, le ciel appartiendra bientôt aux Planeurs d'Ehcatl. Celle-ci a hâte d'être au jour où ceux-ci voleront haut dans le ciel d'Éorzéa !
entries.ja:
ほおッ……空までブッ飛べそうな出来じゃねえかッァ！
いつか一緒に数千ヤルムの上空から、
ガルーダ様にシッポ振る連中を見下してやろうぜッェ！

entries.en: Ixal though you are not, far better than obnoxious buzzards of logging grounds, you are. Count you as  of Ehcatl, I do.

entries.fr: Mais avant ça, ceux-ci vont devoir régler le problème des fourbes du site de déboisement... Si  est vraiment du côté de ceux-ci, qu' continue à les aider dans leur lutte !
entries.ja:
しっかし、伐採所の連中はイケ好かないヤツばかりだッァ。
裏でコソコソ立ち回って、ほんと情けねえヤツらだねッェ！

entries.en: You now have access to the crafting facility.
entries.fr: Vous pouvez maintenant utiliser les installations d'artisanat.
entries.ja: 製作の準備が整った。

entries.en: Normal-quality items crafted in the course of this quest serve no purpose and cannot be sold. It is recommended that you discard them.
entries.fr: Les objets de qualité normale fabriqués au cours de cette quête n'ayant aucune utilité et ne pouvant être vendus, il est recommandé de les jeter.
entries.ja:
本クエストで製作した「NQアイテム」を所持しています。
このアイテムは、使用することはありません。
売却もできませんので、不用でしたら破棄してください。
